about: Blocky case terrain grid for Jebel Ali. Layer values are x10 integers (null = no data); row 0 = north; corners are block centres. Written by tools/process_jebel_ali.py.
block_text: one block = 3×3 filtered pixels of 30 m = 9×9 NISAR 10 m pixels ≈ 90 m

layers.label: Pass 18 Jun 2026 (before)
layers.what: NISAR HH backscatter (how much of the radar beam came back)

layers.label: Pass 28 Oct 2026 (after)
layers.what: NISAR HH backscatter (how much of the radar beam came back)

layers.label: Change: after vs before (background removed)
layers.what: HH change after removing each side's smooth 2 km background (method in the numbers file)
layers.source: NISAR L2 GCOV, track 056 ascending; median of 1 before / 1 after passes
layers.note: Includes a contaminated pass (see the verdict): not a reliable change map yet.
